# M72 resumed hosted browser verification

Date: 2026-09-15, after the board reported the blocking Chrome extension panel closed. Root used the supported browser interface on https://www.neuvetra.ai/ with the existing admitted browser session. No new account, authentication credential, application save or review was created. Earlier blocked observations remain in the immutable review reports.

- The live default Corporate coverage view loaded the saved corrected company, version2 and86 recorded unresolved findings. California example, incomplete inventory and no assurance remain explicit. Two California entities/facilities were visible.
- History and review displayed corrected version2 and its accepted bounded internal review separately from the frozen export. The correction reason and limitations were readable. Keyboard Home/Enter selected original version1; End/Enter returned to version2. Version1 remained unreviewed.

The UI confirmed the download and explained that later review decisions are excluded.

- At390x844, navigation and controls wrapped within the viewport. Read-only DOM measurement reported viewport390/document375, with no horizontal overflow. The saved version selector and unresolved-findings control remained usable. Normal viewport restored afterward.
- Fresh signed-in browser read occurred after the previously verified real hosted restart and final deployment. No further database mutation was needed. # M72 hosted visual acceptance supplement

Date: 2026-09-15. Reviewer: `/root/m72_qa`, continuing the existing QA assignment. Requested compute remains gpt-6-astra/high; observed settings unknown. This reviewer did not author the product or root's browser evidence, did not operate the hosted browser and made no hosted request or credential operation. Root performed the browser interactions; this reviewer independently inspected the retained screenshots, interaction report and actual downloaded file. Prior blocked reports and immutable snapshots remain unchanged.

## Scope and evidence

The board reported closing the Chrome extension panel that had paused automation. Root then used the existing admitted browser session at `https://www.neuvetra.ai/`. The latest retained provider observation identifies successful deployment `6d6c12ff-f635-4293-abce-9d1832d75b4a`, published source `54d89f31ac08c7fe6f46fed68daf9f9e362ed6da`, and the same reviewed application image digest `sha256:7e8d7e0549ba1ed66f7414f1f227c01bba77a51a43e0120fba8a58ea3aa44799`. Root's final publication observation records all six required checks passing and a 57-stage read-only revisit after that deployment. These provider observations are root-executed evidence, not new provider checks by this reviewer.

Inspected [root's browser report](m72-browser-verification.md), [history screenshot](m72-browser-history.png), [narrow screenshot](m72-browser-narrow.png), [focused-control observation](m72-browser-history.txt) and [download comparison](m72-browser-download-check.json).

| Check | Evidence-backed disposition |
| --- | --- |
| Saved correction and separate review | **Pass.** The wide screenshot visibly shows version 2, the corrected fictional company label, correction reason, accepted bounded internal review and an explanation that frozen exports exclude later reviews. These agree with the previously verified hosted register. |
| Unresolved coverage and limits | **Pass.** Screenshots visibly retain the California example, incomplete inventory/no assurance labels, 86 saved findings, 15 Scope 3 category count and unreleased-method/filing/assurance caveats. Root's interaction report additionally records viewing every Scope 3 category and stationary-combustion missing evidence, unsupported method, unassessed activity and unavailable emissions. That category/detail traversal is root-observed evidence; the screenshots independently show the summary and limitations. |
| Earlier version selection and real download | **Pass.** Root records keyboard Home/Enter selection of version 1 and End/Enter return to version 2. The narrow screenshot shows version 1 selected; the wide screenshot shows version 2 selected and confirms the version 1 download. The focused-control text is only a short observation, not a full accessibility audit. |
| Exact downloaded bytes | **Pass, independently recomputed.** Read the actual browser-created `C:/Users/nimab/Downloads/california-coverage-version-1 (2).json`. It is 25,651 UTF-8 bytes, SHA-256 `beab72652b26edc756e43df6932a982dad7a7f8fff0c59473a57b9b4abd70845`. Decoding through the actual frontend version decoder passed; the complete file text equals the canonical retained version 1 with `review: null`. This verifies the real download, not only the root comparison flag. |
| Narrow layout and keyboard operation | **Pass within observed controls.** The narrow screenshot shows navigation/actions wrapping, a readable version selector and no visible horizontal clipping. Root measured viewport 390/document 375 at 390×844 and recorded no horizontal overflow, then restored the normal viewport. This is a bounded layout/keyboard check, not comprehensive accessibility certification. |
| Fresh read after restart/deployment | **Pass.** Root's current signed-in browser interaction occurs after the independently assessed restart and final deployment readback. No new account, save or review was needed. It visually matches the two retained versions verified earlier. |

## Recommendation and limits

**PASS for the resumed hosted saved-workflow visual gate. Recommend closing the earlier browser-blocked acceptance item for M72's bounded rollout**, together with the prior API, preservation, recovery and restart evidence. The existing site can now demonstrate the saved correction, separate internal review, unresolved coverage and exact earlier download. Board feedback remains the coordinator's next gate before dependent work.

The now-saved host was not reset to an empty register. The initial empty case remains covered by the pre-save hosted API exercise and prior local browser tests; a new hosted empty-state visual demonstration is not claimed. Fresh hosted save/correction/review form submissions were also not repeated in this read-only visual session. Their persisted outcomes and current history/export controls were examined here, while previous local browser and hosted API evidence cover those creation paths. These distinctions must remain explicit rather than relabeling this session as a new end-to-end browser write test.

No full corporate inventory, corporate emissions total, released accounting method, legal applicability determination or independent external assurance is delivered by this gate. This supplement does not alter the earlier reports' truthful blocked status at their original observation times. A later application change requires affected checks again; publication observations and any final metadata-only deployment remain root-owned.
